The Multiple Quantity of Product in Shop app enhances Odoo eCommerce functionality by enabling Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) settings for products across multiple websites. Users can configure MOQ for all products, specific products, or website-specific items, optimizing sales and inventory control.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **MOQ for Website:**  
       - Set a Minimum Order Quantity for all products on a specific website.  

    2) **MOQ for Product:**  
       - Define an MOQ at the product level, allowing website-specific control.  

    3) **Set MOQ for All Websites:**  
       - Establish a global MOQ across multiple websites.  

    4) **Ignore All MOQs:**  
       - Exempt specific products from MOQ restrictions with a single setting.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Multi-Website eCommerce Management:** Set different MOQ rules for multiple websites.  
    - **Flexible Order Quantity Control:** Customize product-based MOQ settings.

name: Product Multiple Website

description:
The Sale Line Description on MRP-Workorder and Picking module enhances clarity in manufacturing and logistics by automatically transferring sales and purchase order line descriptions to related documents. It ensures that product descriptions from sales orders appear in delivery orders, Manufacturing Orders (MO), and MRP Workorders, while purchase order descriptions are included in picking receipts and delivery documents. This improves traceability, operational efficiency, and documentation accuracy.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Sale Order Line Description on Delivery Order:**  
       - Sales order line descriptions are automatically transferred to the delivery order lines.  

    2) **Sales Description on Manufacturing and Work Orders:**  
       - Sales order line descriptions are automatically carried over to the Manufacturing Order and Workorder.  

    3) **Purchase Order Line Description on Receipt:**  
       - Purchase order line descriptions are automatically included in the receipt document.  

    4) **Visible Descriptions in Picking Operations:**  
       - Sales and purchase order descriptions are displayed in stock picking operations.  

    5) **Print Descriptions in PDF Reports:**  
       - The transferred descriptions are included in picking operation PDF reports for better clarity.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Manufacturing & Production Planning:** Ensure accurate documentation of sales order descriptions in MOs and work orders.  
    - **Warehouse & Logistics:** Improve stock picking accuracy by including sales and purchase descriptions in delivery orders and receipts.  
    - **Procurement & Supply Chain:** Maintain clear communication between procurement, warehousing, and manufacturing teams.  
    - **Order Fulfillment & Customer Service:** Provide detailed product information in delivery and picking documents for smooth operations.
